page: Microsoft Azure DC2as_v6 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCasv6 server family. It features an x86_64 AMD processor with 2 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) and 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and does not include local storage or integrated graphics processing units (GPUs).

This instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing users to attach external high-performance storage volumes to compensate for the lack of default local storage. It does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring external network configuration for public internet access.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio position this instance as a reliable entry-level option for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without the variability of burstable models. It is suitable for general-purpose workloads, lightweight web serving, small databases, and development or testing environments.
